about.title: About Fidelis Auto
about.description: Fidelis Auto is a home for car lovers. We verify, document, and share the stories behind every car we feature.
about.fidelisLatin: Fidelis — from the Latin for "faithful" — represents our commitment to honesty, transparency, and trust in every car we feature.
about.weBuiltIt: We built Fidelis Auto because we love cars. Not just the rare ones, not just the expensive ones — all of them. We believe every car has a story worth telling, and we believe that story should be told honestly.
about.whyWeExistDesc: The car market is full of noise. Misleading listings, hidden histories, exaggerated claims. We wanted something different — a place where every car is documented thoroughly, where buyers can trust what they see, and where sellers can present their cars with the pride they deserve.
about.verifiedDocumentationDesc: Every service record, ownership change, and detail is presented transparently. We don't claim history — we show it.
about.honestPhotographyDesc: Real photos, real condition. No deceptive angles, no misleading edits. What you see is what you get.
about.aHomeForEveryCarDesc: Whether it's a weekend sports car, a daily driver with history, or a once-in-a-generation find — if it has a story, it belongs here.
about.builtForMENA: Built for the Middle East, Open to the World
about.builtForMENADesc: Born in Egypt, built for the global car community. We connect enthusiasts across the Middle East, Europe, and beyond.
about.whatsNextDesc: Fidelis Auto starts as a curated showcase and will grow into a global platform where car lovers can discover, share, and transact with confidence. Every feature we build serves one purpose: making it easier to trust the story behind the car.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: Fidelis Auto privacy policy — how we collect, use, and protect your data.
privacy.section1Desc: We collect information you provide directly when you register an account, submit a vehicle listing, or contact us. This includes your name, email address, phone number, and any details you provide about your vehicle.
privacy.section2Desc: We use your information to: operate and maintain your account, process and manage vehicle listings, send you verification emails and SMS codes, respond to your inquiries, and improve our services.
privacy.section3Desc: We do not sell your personal information. We may share data with service providers who help us operate the platform (such as email delivery and SMS providers), and we may disclose information when required by law.
privacy.section4Desc: We take reasonable measures to protect your data, including secure password storage (hashed) and HTTPS encryption. However, no method of transmission over the Internet is 100% secure.
privacy.section5Desc: We use cookies to keep you logged in and to remember your preferences. You can disable cookies in your browser, but some features may not function properly.
privacy.section6Desc: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data at any time by contacting us. You can also delete your account by contacting our support team.
privacy.section7Desc: If you have questions about this privacy policy, contact us at aeeg.education@gmail.com.
